internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root paradigm is a clean three-cell valence set: أَوَى (I) = settle oneself at a place (Cave, rock, mountain, a strong support), always intransitive with إِلَىٰ + terminus; آوَى (IV) = the morphological causative, lodge/harbour/take another in (Joseph draws his brother to himself, God shelters the orphan, the Anṣār give shelter); and مَأْوَىٰ = the resulting place-of-settling. The intuitive reading 'refuge/shelter/safe haven' fits every verb but is refuted at scale by the noun: 19 of 22 مَأْوَىٰ occurrences make it the Fire — the antithesis of a haven, indeed (32:20) a place of forced return. The only account covering all 36 is therefore the thin, polarity-neutral 'place reached as destination-abode / act of coming-to-settle', with 'protection' demoted to a frequent connotation of the verbal class alone.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Awy does NOT entail: (1) safety/protection/rescue — the Fire is a مَأْوَىٰ (79:39, 24:57, 29:25), and the sheltering act can fail (11:43 the mountain-refuge is nullified, فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ); (2) positive or negative polarity — set wholly by the complement (Fire vs Garden), proven by the minimal pair 79:39 ↔ 79:41; (3) mere motion/going — it is arrival-and-rest at a terminus (إِلَىٰ marks the end-point), never passage; (4) building or owning a dwelling — it is resorting-to / being-lodged-at an existing locus; (5) help/aid — آوَى is explicitly paired with and distinct from نَصَرَ (8:26, 8:72, 8:74); (6) permanence or voluntariness of the lodged — Cave/embrace are temporary, and the damned do not choose the Fire.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 79:39:4:2 فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ names Hellfire the maʾwā, read against its minimal pair 79:41:4:2 ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (the Garden the maʾwā) and against 32:20:4:2 where the Fire is a maʾwā of forced return (كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا). The identical noun denotes Hellfire and Garden alike, and denotes a locus of confinement one is forced back into: this falsifies any 'refuge/shelter/safety' nucleus and forces the root down to the valence-neutral 'place reached as destination-abode', collapsing the vivid protective verbal reading.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: 'Awy = refuge / shelter / safe haven (a place of safety one resorts to or provides).' It fits all 14 verbal occurrences elegantly (mountain, cave, rock, strong support, taking in the orphan 93:6, emigrants 8:72/8:74, family 12:69/12:99, Jesus and his mother 23:50) and even جَنَّة المَأْوَىٰ. It is rejected as the nucleus because it is Quran-internally disproven by the ~19 punitive Fire-maʾwā nouns (the maximally un-safe place), and is retained only as a frequent connotation of the verbal class. Its rejection is exactly what fixes the narrower neutral nucleus.

STRONG/UNIVERSAL is capped for two contract-specified reasons: (a) a COHERENT LEXICALIZED NOMINAL SUB-CLASS — مَأْوَىٰ is distributionally frozen to the eschatological terminal-abode (0/22 mundane dwellings) and 19/22 invert the protective feature that unifies the verbs, i.e. material valence resistance to the richer account; and (b) DISTINCTIVENESS is only suggestive, not adversarially clean: in 3:151 مَأْوَىٰ (Awy) and مَثْوَىٰ (θwy) co-occur in one verse both denoting the Fire, showing overlap rather than sharp contrast from the nearest neighbour. independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B distinctiveness-weighted, C adversarial) converged on REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE and on the punitive مَأْوَىٰ sub-class as the sole cap driver.
candidate_root_contribution: An animate entity coming-to-settle / being-lodged at a locus reached as destination-abode. Form I (intransitive + إلى): the subject betakes itself to / takes up lodging at a fixed point. Form IV (causative-transitive): an agent lodges/houses/takes in another. Noun مَأْوَىٰ (maf'al place-noun): the place where that settling terminates — the abode one ends up in. The nucleus is valence-neutral: safety, benefit, permanence and polarity are context-supplied, not root-entailed.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 36/36 read from the packet: Form I أَوَى + إِلَىٰ + terminus (5), Form IV آوَى transitive causee (9), noun مَأْوَىٰ place-of-settling (22, of which 19 Fire, 3 Garden).
layer_attribution.derivation: Regular I→IV causative alternation ('X settles itself' → 'X settles Y') plus a maf'al place-noun on the same root; morphology transparently tracks the valence and grounds a single root nucleus.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: مَأْوَىٰ is a lexicalized nominal sub-class: distributionally frozen to the eschatological terminal-abode (0/22 mundane), polarity-neutral, and shorn of the verbs' protective feature — the seam that caps strength at MODERATE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Protection/rescue (Cave, mountain, orphan, emigrants) and punishment (Fire) and polarity are contextual/narrative overlays supplied by predicate and complement, NOT part of the root claim; the root contributes only the neutral coming-to-settle/destination-abode relation.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: The intuitive 'refuge' reading is downgraded from nucleus to verbal-class connotation so that the punitive nouns (79:39, 32:20) become consistent rather than resistant; unity is asserted only at the thin schema level, since no Quran-internal verb→noun shared-referent bridge exists.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: Residual, non-fatal: (a) verb↔noun valence asymmetry (protective verbs vs mostly-punitive noun) with no bridging occurrence; (b) distinctiveness from مَثْوَىٰ only suggestive (3:151 co-occurrence). These cap the grade but do not defeat the single neutral nucleus.

hard_cases.reason: The identical noun مَأْوَىٰ denotes Hellfire (79:39) and the Garden (79:41); this pair refutes the intuitive refuge/protection nucleus and fixes the neutral destination-abode reading.

evidence_basis.statement: 79:39:4:2 فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ names Hellfire the maʾwā, read against its minimal pair 79:41:4:2 ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (the Garden the maʾwā).

hard_cases.reason: The Fire as maʾwā is a place of forced no-exit return, the inversion of voluntary refuge, compelling the feature-thin valence-neutral nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 32:20:4:2 where the Fire is a maʾwā of forced return (كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا).

hard_cases.reason: Surface آوي resembles Form IV but is QAC-tagged Form I, and its locus رُكْن شَدِيد is a metaphorical strong support rather than a physical abode, stretching the 'place' argument.

evidence_basis.statement: 11:80:8:1 is QAC-tagged Form I (qac_verb_form null) despite its آوي surface shape; here the locus is a metaphorical strong support, not a physical abode — it stretches but does not break the directional betake-oneself-to-a-fixed-point frame.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence is finally RESISTANT under the adopted polarity-neutral nucleus (it covers all 36). The hard cases are ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY items that refute the richer refuge/protection competitor and a STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY (11:80) — each grounded in a stated evidence basis that also appears in the strongest_counterexample or the relevant cluster/override notes.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal bridge occurrence in which a place a subject Form-I أَوَى-verbed to (e.g. the Cave of 18:10/18:16, the rock of 18:63) is subsequently labelled that same referent's مَأْوَىٰ, OR a مَأْوَىٰ occurrence carrying the verbs' protective/beneficial feature intact — either would let the richer 'refuge' account cover the whole root and lift the cap toward STRONG.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 22 مَأْوَىٰ nouns cross-referenced against the 14 verbal loci (11:43, 11:80, 18:10, 18:16, 18:63, 12:69, 12:99, 23:50, 33:51, 70:13, 8:26, 8:72, 8:74, 93:6), plus the polarity split within the noun (79:39 vs 79:41, 32:19, 53:15).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether any مَأْوَىٰ referent is the same physical shelter named by a verb, and whether any مَأْوَىٰ predicate encodes protection/benefit rather than the neutral end-station; test مَأْوَىٰ against مَثْوَىٰ (3:151) and مَصِير/مِهَاد rhyme-partners for a distinctive contrast.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude contextual/narrative benefit (rescue in a story) from counting as root-borne protection; require the feature to be carried by the derivation itself, not the surrounding predicate or complement (Fire/Garden); rely only on QAC morphology for I vs IV assignment (e.g. 11:80 is Form I).
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such bridge/protective-noun is found, the neutral destination-abode nucleus stands but STRONG remains capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE by the resistant punitive nominal sub-class; if a bridge IS found, the protective account is promoted and the grade is revisited upward.

reopen_conditions: If a مَأْوَىٰ occurrence is shown to denote the very Cave/rock/mountain/ruknْ that a Form I أَوَى verb (18:10, 18:16, 18:63, 11:43, 11:80) resorted to — establishing the verb→noun shared-referent bridge now absent — reopen to test promotion of the protective account.

If re-examination of 3:151 (مَأْوَىٰ alongside مَثْوَىٰ for the Fire) or the مَصِير/مِهَاد rhyme-partners yields a sharp Quran-internal contrast making Awy's contribution adversarially-distinctive, reopen the distinctiveness cap toward STRONG.
If any مَأْوَىٰ is found to be a mundane (non-eschatological) dwelling, reopen the 'lexicalized terminal-abode' characterization of the nominal sub-class.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: Under the polarity-neutral nucleus no occurrence fails, so this is not a refutation (not FAILED); but distinctiveness from the nearest neighbour مَثْوَىٰ is not adversarially clean (3:151 co-occurrence for the same Fire), and a coherent resistant lexicalized nominal sub-class persists — so a genuine SUPPORTED-with-distinctiveness_ok pass cannot be certified.
